newsitem.title: UK: BLENHEIM GAINS ON LATEST BID SPECULATION.
newsitem.headline: BLENHEIM GAINS ON LATEST BID SPECULATION.

text.p: Shares in Blenheim Group Plc rose in early trading on Thursday after a report in the Daily Mail said Reed Elsevier had made a 530p per share offer to Blenheim executives.
If agreed, the paper said the offer would be formally announced today. Blenheim shares were up 12-1/2p at 470 by 0712 GMT, after yesterday dropping 6p from their record close set on October 8.
Dutch publisher VNU took a 14.99 percent stake in Blenheim after a stock market raid on Tuesday, yet Blenheim responded by saying it had received other approaches which may lead to a takeover bid.
VNU said it planned to increase its stake but under stock market rules it would have to offer the same 500p price as its initial purchase.
Reed Elsevier had earlier been rumoured to have been interested in a bid at about 480p per share.
Shares in Reed were initially unchanged at 11.81 stg.
A spokeswoman for Blenheim declined comment on the latest bout of speculation. No-one at Reed Elsevier was immediately available for comment.
